summary: The manuscript passes cold screening for both arXiv and Preprints.org submission with zero blocking defects. Authorship, Google Antigravity / Gemini workflow disclosure with explicit human verification, Google Antigravity for Science acknowledgment, 45 CFR 46.102(e) de-identified secondary-data ethics statement, open-source code/data availability, and retrospective clinical claim framing are all complete, accurate, and internally consistent with the compiled PDF, figures, and bibliographic records.

warnings.detail: Clarify per-split window/subsample sizes in Table 2 and Appendix B: IEEE-CIS (590,540 total rows) and NeurIPS BAF (1,000,000 total rows) evaluate 130k- and 140k-row staggered chronological windows across the full streams, Home Credit (N=140k) is a 140k-row subsample of 307,511 borrowers, and UCI Taiwan has N_train=16.5k alongside the larger cohorts (N_train approx. 54k-77k noted at L250).

Data and Code Availability provides direct URLs/DOIs for UCI datasets (296, 350, 421), OpenML, and NeurIPS BAF, but omits direct Kaggle archive URLs or formal .bib entries for Home Credit Default Risk and IEEE-CIS Fraud Detection, as well as optional citations for the Scania APS dataset paper and foundational Python libraries (NumPy, SciPy, pandas).

AI-Assisted Workflows Disclosure clearly states the role of Google Antigravity powered by Gemini and explicit human verification, but could optionally specify the exact Gemini model version string for finer-grained provenance.
